rules: A Leash equation applies only after anchor, length, state coordinates and physical/metaphorical domain are declared.
A timeline is a path through a transition/state space; 'all timelines' is not a scientific claim until the model defines the path ensemble.
Use EF/AF/AG or hitting probability to distinguish can-reach, must-reach and likely-to-reach.
Use P_aa=1 only for a genuinely absorbing state inside the declared model; metastable or hard-to-exit states are not absorbing.
Use winding/homotopy for topological constraint and Lagrange/complementarity mechanics for physical constraint; they are different mechanisms.
Karmic debt, destiny and providence remain theological/project categories unless a separate empirical variable is explicitly defined.
Determinism, predictability, inevitability and prophecy are not synonyms.
